prompt: /tribunal:deliberate --depth full We're migrating our monolith to microservices. DevOps says it saves ops overhead, but our senior engineer worries about debugging complexity and network latency. Cost is neutral over 2 years. Should we go ahead?

assertions.name: addresses-question
assertions.description: Output contains a clear recommendation (proceed/don't proceed/conditional)

assertions.name: discusses-key-concerns
assertions.description: Output addresses debugging complexity and network latency concerns

assertions.name: structured-response
assertions.description: Output has clear sections or structure (headers, bullets, or paragraphs)
